title: 13-Layer Cr-Dielectric Stack with Reduced Step-Size and Perturbed Initialization
scientific_hypothesis: The score regression from round 1 to round 3 indicates the optimizer is overshooting local minima or encountering parameter-coupling artifacts; reducing step-size to 0.5x and initializing with ±8% perturbations around the round-3 best candidate (thicknesses: [67.27, 211.32, 141.72, 171.96, 203.32, 81.53, 48.56, 89.73, 121.81, 105.50, 134.05, 107.60, 101.25] nm) will probe the loss landscape curvature and potentially recover higher target scores near the round-1 benchmark of 0.6651.
design_principle: Fine-grained optimization near an existing local minimum to determine if sharper minima exist or if the current solution is trapped in a shallow basin due to coarse stepping.
proposed_topology: exactly 13 finite layers from the incident side: Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr
soft_objectives: improve target score relative to round-3 baseline of 0.4612
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds [30, 300] nm maintained from round 3
theory_basis: Admittance Locus Method for metal-dielectric multilayer optimization
Five-Step Optimization Workflow for systematic refinement
expected_advantages: Finer optimization stepping may escape parameter-coupling artifacts
Perturbation initialization tests local landscape curvature
known_risks: May still converge to similar local minimum if landscape is flat
Reduced step-size increases iteration count needed for convergence
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 13-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Optimize a 13-layer planar multilayer stack on Al substrate with material sequence: Cr, HfO2, SiO2, Cr, HfO2, SiO2, Cr, HfO2, SiO2, Cr, HfO2, SiO2, Cr (13 finite layers total). Initialize thicknesses at [67.27, 211.32, 141.72, 171.96, 203.32, 81.53, 48.56, 89.73, 121.81, 105.50, 134.05, 107.60, 101.25] nm with ±8% random perturbations. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with step-size multiplier reduced to 0.5x. Thickness bounds: [30, 300] nm for all layers. Spectral objectives: maximize absorptance in 400-700 nm, maximize reflectance in 700-2000 nm. Normal incidence, unpolarized light. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 700-2000 nm. soft objectives: high absorptance in 400-700 nm; low reflectance in 400-700 nm; high reflectance in 700-2000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance in 400-700 nm; high absorptance in 700-2000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 20.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: reduce optimizer step-size to 0.5x and initialize with ±8% perturbations around round-3 best candidate to probe loss landscape curvature near 0.4612 target score.
